response.headline: Right on target at {{pct_of_target}}, with {{total_premium}} written
paragraphs: Premium was about the same as last week at {{total_premium}} across {{policies_written}} policies, and auto was busy with {{line.auto.policies}} policies written. Retention was healthy at {{retention_rate}}.

Priya Raman was well ahead at {{producer.priya_raman.pct_of_target}} of target. Grant Fowler is at {{producer.grant_fowler.pct_of_target}} and kept {{producer.grant_fowler.retention_rate}} of his renewals, which is the main thing to look at this week.
